steps.title: One adjective, several forms
steps.body: An adjective agrees with its noun in gender, number and case. In хорошее письмо, the adjective describes a neuter singular noun. хоро́ший is the dictionary form: masculine singular nominative. The following forms belong to the same adjective meaning good.

steps.title: Two spelling conditions
steps.body: After ж, ц, ч, ш, or щ, an unstressed о in an ending is written е. That replacement is not a rule for every unstressed о. In хоро́шее, the unstressed ending after ш uses е. The и in хоро́шие follows a different spelling condition: write и rather than ы after ш. Spelling limits the letters in an ending; gender, number and case determine which form is needed.

steps.title: Gender and a worked case change
steps.body: хоро́шая is feminine singular nominative; хоро́шее is neuter singular nominative. In хоро́шая книга, both words are feminine singular nominative. To put the phrase in the accusative singular, change both words: хоро́шая книга becomes хоро́шую книгу. Keep the same noun and feminine singular agreement. хоро́шего друга is masculine animate; хоро́шие книги is plural.

steps.title: Singular, plural and dictionary form
steps.body: хоро́шие is plural nominative. To change хоро́шее from neuter singular nominative to plural nominative, choose хоро́шие. To go back to neuter singular, choose хоро́шее. To supply the dictionary form, choose хоро́ший. These choices test the requested form of the adjective; all the options are already correctly spelled.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the requested adjective form. Use its gender, number and case, then read the explanation.

steps.title: Review forms and spelling
steps.body:
An adjective agrees with its noun in gender, number and case. In хорошее письмо, the adjective describes a neuter singular noun. хоро́ший is the dictionary form: masculine singular nominative. The following forms belong to the same adjective meaning good.

After ж, ц, ч, ш, or щ, an unstressed о in an ending is written е. That replacement is not a rule for every unstressed о. In хоро́шее, the unstressed ending after ш uses е. The и in хоро́шие follows a different spelling condition: write и rather than ы after ш. Spelling limits the letters in an ending; gender, number and case determine which form is needed.

хоро́шая is feminine singular nominative; хоро́шее is neuter singular nominative. In хоро́шая книга, both words are feminine singular nominative. To put the phrase in the accusative singular, change both words: хоро́шая книга becomes хоро́шую книгу. Keep the same noun and feminine singular agreement. хоро́шего друга is masculine animate; хоро́шие книги is plural.

хоро́шие is plural nominative. To change хоро́шее from neuter singular nominative to plural nominative, choose хоро́шие. To go back to neuter singular, choose хоро́шее. To supply the dictionary form, choose хоро́ший. These choices test the requested form of the adjective; all the options are already correctly spelled.

scoredItems.prompt: Which feminine object phrase matches the shown nominative phrase?
scoredItems.feedback: но́вая книга takes the feminine object phrase но́вую книгу.
distractorRationales: но́вого друга is masculine animate, not the feminine object phrase.
но́вые книги is plural, not the feminine singular object phrase.

distractorDifference: но́вого друга is masculine animate, not the feminine object phrase.
но́вые книги is plural, not the feminine singular object phrase.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: The shown phrase is feminine singular, so the object row is но́вую книгу.

scoredItems.prompt: Which genitive phrase continues the shown neuter nominative?
scoredItems.feedback: но́вое окно continues as the genitive phrase но́вого окна.
distractorRationales: но́вую книгу is a feminine object phrase, not the neuter genitive.
но́вый дом is a masculine nominative, not the neuter genitive.

distractorDifference: но́вую книгу is a feminine object phrase, not the neuter genitive.
но́вый дом is a masculine nominative, not the neuter genitive.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: The neuter nominative но́вое окно is distinguished from the feminine object phrase.

scoredItems.prompt: Which plural nominative form of the same adjective corresponds to the shown form?
scoredItems.feedback: но́вый is the masculine singular nominative form; но́вые is the plural nominative form of the same adjective.
distractorRationales: но́вая is the feminine singular nominative form, so it does not supply the requested plural nominative form.

distractorDifference: но́вая is the feminine singular nominative form, so it does not supply the requested plural nominative form.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: но́вый is the masculine singular nominative form; но́вые is the plural nominative form of the same adjective.

scoredItems.prompt: Which dictionary form (masculine singular nominative) belongs to the same adjective as the shown form?
scoredItems.feedback: но́вая is the feminine singular nominative form; но́вый is the masculine singular nominative form of the same adjective.
distractorRationales: но́вое is the neuter singular nominative form, so it does not supply the requested masculine singular nominative form.

distractorDifference: но́вое is the neuter singular nominative form, so it does not supply the requested masculine singular nominative form.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: но́вая is the feminine singular nominative form; но́вый is the masculine singular nominative form of the same adjective.

scoredItems.prompt: Which admitted form agrees with the shown word?
scoredItems.feedback: но́вая agrees with the shown feminine singular noun in the nominative, as in the retained new car phrase. но́вый is masculine singular and но́вые is plural. Choose the form that matches the noun in this phrase, rather than the dictionary form or a plural form.
distractorRationales: но́вый is nominative masculine singular instead of the feminine singular agreement required here.
но́вые is nominative plural instead of the singular agreement required here.

distractorDifference: но́вый is nominative masculine singular instead of the feminine singular agreement required here.
но́вые is nominative plural instead of the singular agreement required here.
assessment.whyAnswerDemonstratesObjective: но́вая agrees with the shown feminine singular noun in the nominative, as in the retained new car phrase. но́вый is masculine singular and но́вые is plural. Choose the form that matches the noun in this phrase, rather than the dictionary form or a plural form.
